scope: scripts/qualify_progress_reporting.py on Debug builds of d62587fa, 9/9 steps. Host A in one owned TIA V21 Update 3 scratch (CPU 1511-1 PN): change_status of a prepared tag_create reported projectEditComplete=false with the prepared-only summary; its apply reported projectEditComplete=true with checkpointSaved, recoveryArchiveCreated, projectChanged, compiled and saved done, compilerSucceeded yes, and notCovered naming host_build_identity; two change_status progressOnly polls of the finished change returned the same phaseFingerprint, state applied and no current phase. Host B, configured with a copied engineering worker it never started: host_build_identity reported the worker hash at Host start equal to now and runningMatchesDisk=true; after one byte was appended to the copy it reported changedOnDisk=true, runningMatchesDisk=false and a note to restart the Host.
limitations: Milestones are derived from the recorded state, stages and compile result of each change; a phase still running during a poll was not observed natively because the tag change finished too quickly.
host_build_identity compares file hashes, not source revisions: builds do not embed a commit, so mapping a hash to a commit needs the build records.

steps: a prepared-only change reports nothing changed
the applied change reports a complete, saved and compiled edit
repeated progress polls of a finished change are unchanged
a worker replaced after Host start is reported as changed on disk
